propositions: A single in-flight wipChain record on one instance serializes landing so two changes are never rebased onto the same HEAD concurrently, with phase in {selecting, rebasing, awaiting_verified, submitting, idle, paused}.
A fast-forward-only TOCTOU guard re-confirms the tested tree is still submittable immediately before POST /submit and refuses to submit if main advanced or any tested SHA changed.
On TOCTOU failure or a 'not fast-forward' refusal, the same wipChain is re-driven (rebase to new tip, await fresh Verified, re-check) at most N=5 times tracked by re_drive_count.
After re-drive exhaustion the change is handed back by removing Autosubmit from every stack member, posting a Gerrit comment naming needs_rebase, and writing S3's needs_rebase marker.
Gerrit's native submittable flag does not distinguish behind-tip from failing votes, so the loop must interpret submittable=True as votes-at-MAX and on-tip.
Tests must cover each phase transition, the TOCTOU guard for SHA-mismatch and main-advanced, the bounded re-drive, and the hand-back signals.
